name: iSAQB Community-Meetup Rhein/Main: Eine Architektur, viele Sichten
description: software architecture meetup on consistent architecture views and diagram-as-code tools
details:
20th community meetup of the iSAQB software architecture group Rhein/Main, together with JUG Darmstadt. Gerd Aschemann and Falk Sippach (embarc) show how to keep context, building block, runtime and deployment views consistent.

They compare draw.io, Mermaid, PlantUML, Structurizr and LikeC4, demo a versionable model that generates diagrams and syncs changes both ways, and discuss AI assistants as a source of context. Talk about 18:30-19:30, then networking; ACCSO provides drinks and finger food.
note: German; with JUG Darmstadt; same evening as PHPUGMRN
